plugins.name: wondel-auto-router
plugins.description: Routing layer for the wondel.ai skills library: classifies every task and loads the matching skills automatically. Engineering tasks get a mandatory 11-skill multifocal baseline (Clean Code, Pragmatic Programmer, Refactoring, Legacy Code, Software Design, Release It!, DDIA, High Perf Browser, UX Heuristics, Microinteractions, Steve Jobs Design Review) plus context-specific additions for greenfield, iOS, and visual work.
